record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: composer-e2e-test
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: The R10 acceptance passes with the e2e and packaging modules together.
    observed: Both modules use the installed fixture; the second install collided on a fixed source directory (11 passed, 4 errors).
    severity: major
  - task: composer-e2e-test
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: The replay matches the init skill's position call, including phase.
    observed: The position is created without phase; the schema marks phase optional and validate passes.
    severity: minor
  - task: composer-e2e-test
    kind: missing-test
    expected: R9 detects any change to the live store.
    observed: The hash covers file names only, not contents or sizes.
    severity: minor
integration:
  interfaces: One module-scoped fixture runs the whole flow once through the installed entry points; nine tests assert R1 to R9.
  assumptions: Earlier phases are merged.
  invariants: Assertions are real; commands match the skills except position phase; temporary state only.
  conflicts: Fixture registered twice, colliding on the fixed source directory.
record.subject: composer-e2e-review
